# Les Nuits au Château — shared project knowledge

Canonical snapshot date: 2026-08-09
Language: French
Project: two high-end private guest suites at Château de Sainte-Lucie, Rambervillers, opening target April 2027.

Read these machine-readable files:
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/knowledge/project.json — identity, offer, rules, prices
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/knowledge/business-model.json — formulas, assumptions, staffing
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/knowledge/market.json — benchmark and pricing logic
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/knowledge/investments.json — active 65k investment envelope
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/knowledge/roadmap.json — milestones and external validations
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/knowledge/sources.json — provenance and limitations

Interpretation rules:
1. Prefer the most recent dated structured file over archived documents.
2. Distinguish validated facts, working assumptions and external-validation requirements.
3. Do not treat the simulator as an accountant-approved forecast.
4. Do not infer sensitive legal, financial or personal data absent from these files.
5. When recommending a change, state which current fact or assumption it would replace and why.
6. The active annual simulator uses a provisional EUR 28k employer budget for Jules, auto-calculated relief, a fixed EUR 65k capex outside annual P&L, and SCI rent equal to the positive residual capacity after reserve.

Human interface:
- /chateau-sainte-lucie-site/demo/pilotage/
